plugin.name: Tasks Map
plugin.description: A graph view of your tasks

commands.focus_project_or_task: Focus project or task in map
commands.insert_filter_as_code_block: Insert current filter as embedded Tasks Map
commands.check_note_map_visibility: Check why note is (not) shown in map

settings.auto_refresh_desc: Update open task maps after Markdown task or project files change. Automatic refreshes preserve the current camera.
settings.show_task_priorities_desc: Display priority indicators on task nodes
settings.priority_accent_position_desc: Choose where the priority color strip appears on task nodes
settings.show_status_counts_desc: Display a status counts overlay on the canvas
settings.node_density_desc: Choose comfortable task cards or compact one-line cards that reveal details on hover and selection
settings.attachment_type_markdown_desc: Show owned attachment notes under task nodes
settings.attachment_type_pdf_desc: Show PDF attachments under task nodes
settings.attachment_type_image_desc: Show common image attachments under task nodes
settings.attachment_type_file_desc: Show non-note file attachments under task nodes
settings.editor_autosave_desc: Write changes in the task editor panel to disk automatically as you type. When off, an explicit Save button is shown.
settings.edge_style_desc: The line style used for connections between nodes
settings.smooth_step_radius_desc: Border radius for smooth step corners (0 = sharp right angles)
settings.sidebar_width_desc: Width in pixels of the left sidebar (unlinked tasks and project tree panels)
settings.tag_color_palette_desc: Choose a color theme for tags
settings.task_statuses_desc: Configure the available task statuses. Each status maps to a checkbox character (for Tasks-plugin tasks) and one or more frontmatter values (for note-based tasks).
settings.task_priorities_desc: Configure priority values from the TaskNotes task type file, or fall back to Task Map's own saved priorities. Colors are saved by Task Map.
settings.tasknotes_schema_use_desc: Read and write priority values from the vault's task type definition when available.
settings.tasknotes_schema_path_desc: Vault-relative path to the TaskNotes task type definition.
settings.tasknotes_schema_unsaved: Priority changes are not written to the task type file until you apply them.
settings.tasknotes_schema_write_empty: Add at least one priority before applying.
settings.tasknotes_schema_write_failed: Could not update the TaskNotes task type file.
settings.default_status_filter_desc: Statuses shown when the map is opened. Enabling every status (or disabling every status) shows them all.
settings.linking_style_desc: How task dependencies are specified in simple tasks
settings.linking_individual_desc: Each dependency with its own emoji identifier
settings.linking_dataview_desc: Dependencies using Dataview inline field syntax
settings.note_task_property_name_desc: The frontmatter property used to identify a note as a task (e.g. "tags" or "type")
settings.note_task_property_value_desc: A note is treated as a task when the property above contains one of these values. Separate multiple values with commas (e.g. "task, project")
settings.note_task_title_source_desc: Choose the label shown for note-based tasks in Tasks Map.
settings.note_task_title_property_desc: Frontmatter property used as the visible task title. Missing or empty values fall back to the filename.
settings.note_task_date_prefix_desc: Add a YYYY-MM-DD prefix to visible note-task titles.
settings.note_task_created_date_property_desc: Frontmatter property containing the creation date. Missing or invalid dates are omitted.
settings.note_dependency_property_desc: The frontmatter property holding dependency note links (e.g. "blockedBy" or "projects"). Accepts a list of [[wiki links]].
settings.quick_comments_property_desc: The frontmatter property used for quick updates shown on note task and project nodes.
settings.task_organizer_excluded_folders_desc: Vault-relative folders ignored by the organizer. Separate multiple folders with commas or new lines.
settings.task_organizer_rename_project_folders_de: When off, existing folders under projects/<project> are preserved so date-prefixed project folders keep their sort order.
settings.task_organizer_rename_task_folders_desc: When off, existing folders under projects/<project>/<task> are preserved. New task folders still use a deterministic fallback name.
settings.task_organizer_orphans_desc: Choose how task notes with no project link are handled during organization.
settings.task_organizer_ai_names_desc: Generate short semantic names only when task folder renaming is enabled. Project folders and note filenames are not AI-renamed.
settings.task_organizer_ai_provider_desc: Provider used only for task folder naming.
settings.task_organizer_ai_model_desc: Model name used for task folder naming.
settings.task_organizer_ai_api_key_desc: Stored in this plugin's local settings and used only for task folder naming.
settings.task_organizer_preview_desc: Show the planned note, folder, and attachment changes before applying them.
settings.debug_visualization_desc: Show additional debug information in the graph view
settings.language_desc: Select the language for the plugin interface

visibility.title: Tasks Map note visibility
visibility.context_live: Checked against the currently open map.
visibility.context_defaults: No standalone map is open; checked against the configured defaults.
visibility.verdict_shown: This note is currently shown on the map.
visibility.verdict_should_show: This note should be shown when a map opens.
visibility.verdict_stale: The open map has a stale copy of this note.
visibility.verdict_hidden: The note is recognized, but the current map hides it.
visibility.verdict_excluded: The note is not recognized as a task or project.
visibility.verdict_pending: The map is still loading; visibility is not final yet.
visibility.verdict_not_rendered: The note passes the map rules but has not been rendered.

reasons.missing_frontmatter: No parsed frontmatter is available for this note.
reasons.parse_error: The note matched the task criteria but could not be parsed: {{error}}
reasons.parsed: Parsed successfully as a note-based task.
reasons.status_fallback: Status ‘{{raw}}’ is not configured and falls back to ‘{{resolved}}’.
reasons.no_live_map: There is no open standalone map, so live filters and snapshot state cannot be checked.
reasons.map_loading: The open map is still loading its task snapshot.
reasons.snapshot_current: The loaded map snapshot matches the current note.
reasons.stale_missing: The current note is eligible but is absent from the loaded map snapshot.
reasons.stale_changed: The loaded map has older values for: {{fields}}.
reasons.unlinked_allowed: The unlinked-task rule allows this note on the canvas.
reasons.unlinked_hidden: This task has no resolved connections and ‘Hide unlinked tasks’ is enabled.
reasons.selected_tags: Its tags do not match the selected tags: {{selected}}.
reasons.excluded_tags: It contains a currently excluded tag: {{selected}}.
reasons.selected_statuses: Its mapped status is ‘{{actual}}’; visible statuses are {{selected}}.
reasons.selected_files: Its file is outside the selected files or folders: {{selected}}.
reasons.selected_projects: Its projects are {{actual}}; selected projects are {{selected}}.
reasons.only_starred: The map is showing starred tasks only, and this note is not starred.
reasons.root_scope: The note is outside the subtree rooted at {{root}}.
reasons.search_scope: The note is outside the results and traversal for search ‘{{query}}’.
reasons.filters_pass: The note passes all current filters and graph scope rules.
reasons.rendered: A rendered task node exists for this note.
reasons.render_missing: No rendered task node exists even though the note passes the current rules.
